sources.title: Best Open Source AI Models & LLM Leaderboard (2026)
sources.snippet: What are the best open source AI models in 2026? The top open source AI models in 2026 include Meta's Llama 4 family, DeepSeek R1 and V3, Mistral's Large and Medium models, Alibaba's Qwen 2.5 series, and Google's Gemma. These models offer competitive performance with full access to model weights, enabling self-hosting and fine-tuning.
